name: vm-02-mining
eval: window.__afterTeleport=()=>{const D=window.__DD__;const p=D.game.player;let best=null,bd=9;for(let x=-4;x<=4;x++)for(let y=-1;y<=3;y++)for(let z=-4;z<=4;z++){const X=Math.floor(p.x)+x,Y=Math.floor(p.y)+y,Z=Math.floor(p.z)+z;if(D.block(X,Y,Z)!==7)continue;const d=Math.hypot(X+0.5-p.x,Y+0.5-p.y-1.6,Z+0.5-p.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=[X,Y,Z];}}if(best){D.aimAt(best[0],best[1],best[2]);D.input({mining:true});}};
